dedupe_keys.name: enerdata h2 and derivatives projects database hydrogen ammonia methanol and e fuel projects worldwide commercial

description: Enerdata sells an online H2 and Derivatives Projects Database that monitors emerging hydrogen projects. The product page claims more than 95 percent global coverage by volume for projects above 100 MW, projects in 80 countries, and inclusion of derivatives such as ammonia, methanol and e-fuels. For each project it lists name, location, shareholders, operators, development phase, status, key dates such as construction launch, commissioning or hold, initial investment with capex and opex, planned electrolysis, hydrogen and derivative capacities, the electricity source (solar, wind, storage, hydro or grid), electrolysis technology, blue hydrogen by reforming with CCUS, CO2 capture capacity, offtakers and EPC contractors, and the end-use sector. Stated uses include tracking projects by size, location and developer, modelling potential production capacity by country or company and forecasting green hydrogen capacity. Access is a paid subscription available online, with a free trial, demo and sample on request; licence terms are not published on the page. Coverage is global. Caveats: announced projects are tracked, so many may not be built, and the coverage figures are the vendor's own. Simulation uses are planned hydrogen production and derivative capacity for future energy system and supply chain scenarios. Related records: data-iea-hydrogen-production-infrastructure-projects-database is the free IEA counterpart.
